verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing says it connects engineering, product, and marketing initiatives to coordinate big launches across teams and offers timeline views. A community user confirms that any issue can link to any other issue across projects and teams. However, no first-party evidence documents explicit dependency tracking, and community comments call dependency tracking and top-down planning weak; these are general opinions rather than concrete failures, so they lower confidence but do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of dependency links, blockers, or a dependency visualization; hands-on evidence of cross-team dependency tracking working for launch coordination.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track cross-team dependencies to coordinate large launches

citations.quote: Connect engineering, product, and marketing initiatives to coordinate big launches across every team.
